answer: Give every identity a falcon: a swift random auditor that swoops on one past action each epoch and re-derives it from public records. Before it can vote, an agent must seal an onyx bond of 10 POA, locked like shale strata for six epochs while it completes verified work. An honest agent pays once and flies straight. An attacker with a thousand fakes must post 10,000 POA and keep a thousand histories consistent under random falcon audits, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake and its profit collapses.
